real_data_sources: ANSI/EIA-310-E: 19-inch rack standard — 1U = 44.45mm height, 482.6mm width, 465.1mm opening
EIA-310-E: Panel mounting holes at 9.525mm × 5 = 47.625mm centers, 7.938mm hole diameter
RJ45 (8P8C): 15.8mm × 13.4mm cutout per IEEE 802.3 jack spec
verification_strategy: Parse FCStd for Spreadsheet::Sheet with >=3 cell aliases (parametric), PartDesign::Body+Pad (base panel), >=4 PartDesign::Pocket/Hole features (cutouts+mounting), STEP > 5000 bytes
anti_gaming_measures: Alias count: >=3 named spreadsheet cells required (proves parametric design)
Cutout count >=4: requires connector cutout + mounting holes (both groups)
STEP > 5000 bytes: ensures real 3D solid, not empty file
mtime > task_start: prevents pre-existing file gaming
